message:
I have this one friend who seems to panic at the slightest hint of trouble. Last week, she called me in a tizzy because the weather forecast mentioned a chance of storms. I found myself chuckling as I assured her that I had my go-bag ready and some extra water stored. 

We spent the afternoon chatting about our emergency plans, and I could see her worries start to melt away. It reminded me that sometimes, just being prepared can ease those anxious moments. 

Have you ever had a friend like that? It’s nice to know we can support each other while finding our own calm.
